en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing an artillery exercise in a forested area beside a body of water. Several large field guns are lined up, with soldiers in early 20th‑century uniforms operating them amid clouds of gun smoke. Tall trees frame the scene. Handwritten cursive text covers the upper part of the image and runs along the edges, suggesting it was used as a correspondence postcard.
